says: Following all three notes. Proportion: the head is a third larger and the shoulders narrower. The two black stripes are gone; the back of the coat, the sleeve, the scarf and the skull are now shaded with fine hatching that curves round the form, densest at the turning edge, with a thin sliver of reflected light left along the contour. Folds now describe the body: drag lines pulling toward the chest strap, bunching at the elbow and above the cuff, the scarf wrapping the neck. The face gets a few fine lines under the brow, eye and cheekbone, and the hair is drawn as strands swept back into a tied tail. The spires are single continuous fine lines.
